correctness.rationale: The point component of the open neighborhood complex is the union of the seven cap tetrahedra (complements of Fano lines). Its 1-skeleton is K7, the triangles are 28 noncollinear triples and each belongs to exactly one tetrahedron. For |W|≥4, each missing collinear-triangle loop cones through a fourth point; then collapse all tetrahedra using private triangle faces to obtain simply connected 2-complex. Euler counts yield reduced H2 rank 1 on all 21 five-subsets, 3 on all seven six-subsets, 6 for full seven, zero otherwise, while collinear triple yields S1. Unique-triangle property proves injection of every H2 inclusion over Z. All 168 GL3(F2) signed Lefschetz traces independently computed: orders 1,2,3,4,7 yield 6,-2,0,2,-1, matching rational irreducible six-dimensional character; transitivity of 21 five-subsets and rational irreducibility gives their span. Independent GF2 chain-rank checks verified all 127 induced subsets; integral injectivity is from proof, not GF2 test.
